glyphClassification.digit: single code point in number ranges (General_Category N*)
glyphClassification.punctuation: single code point in punctuation ranges (General_Category P*)
glyphClassification.unknownFutureCodepoints: symbol until the pinned spec is explicitly refreshed

unicode.parityScope: Classification and display plans are pinned. General normalization and engine-backed segmentation have the implementation-specific limits below; exact cross-language output is guaranteed only within that intersection.

renderPlan.output: Ordered per-role display slots; slot cardinality determines head folding and cluster splitting

glyphMaterials.browser: runtime measurement and existing font leaf path; inspect fontInfo().glyphMapping diagnostics

compoundPartMapping.directWholeVowel: one candidate drawing; no implicit member split
compoundPartMapping.cssLiteralWholeCompoundVowel: see fixedCSSWholeVowelMapping and fixedCSSWholeVowelCandidateMapping; missing fixed member regions keeps GLYPH_LAYOUT_UNSUPPORTED with original Hangul
compoundPartMapping.squareHead: see measuredStructuredHeadMapping; CSS literal or unavailable measured regions keep GLYPH_HEAD_UNSUPPORTED with original Hangul
compoundPartMapping.staticAndFontExport: unchanged original-Hangul fallback or explicit unsupported-output diagnostics

measuredStructuredHeadMapping.hiddenHost: defer until visible; no successful mapping claimed before measurement
measuredStructuredHeadMapping.pendingFont: GLYPH_FONT_PENDING; remap with current fitted geometry after load
measuredStructuredHeadMapping.semantics: original text, semantic jamo, seed indices, recipe/binding/path unchanged

explicitMaterialCSS.api: refreshAll(root, {materialCSS: true}) captures; false clears; omitted keeps the last capture
requires: existing material plan and valid measurement before drawing
explicitMaterialCSS.paint: normal CSS cascade; not frozen in the choice snapshot
explicitMaterialCSS.internalProbe: data-fy-material-probe is temporary and is not a public selector contract
explicitMaterialCSS.priority: semantic direct value or none precedes captured visual-leaf choices; candidate locks and source rules remain
explicitMaterialCSS.invalidationDiagnostic: GLYPH_MATERIAL_CSS_INVALIDATED until explicit recapture or clear
explicitMaterialCSS.disabledLeaf: GLYPH_MATERIAL_CSS_DISABLED; original-Hangul fallback for the whole semantic jamo
explicitMaterialCSS.hiddenConnectedHead: CSS choice may be captured; GLYPH_HEAD_UNSUPPORTED remains until valid visible geometry exists
explicitMaterialCSS.detachedHost: connect and explicitly capture again; no deferred capture extension
explicitMaterialCSS.pendingFont: remeasure the last captured choice; old completion cannot restore a cleared or invalidated capture
explicitMaterialCSS.semantics: no new semantic jamo, seed index, saved design field or automatic DOM observation
unchangedUnsupported: semantic CSS head literals; fixed whole candidate-only selection or missing regions

glyphMaterials.cssAuthoring: page > tune > syllable > context > case > jamo > slot > parent slot > role > font; core content does not consume authored text (ADR-035)
glyphMaterials.staticCss: original Hangul without JavaScript; arbitrary external CSS cannot be diagnosed by static renderers
glyphMaterials.structuredOutput: authoring Glyphs.capability refuses unsupported targets; FontKkuExport refuses glyph mapping designs before output
glyphMaterials.semantics: original text, semantic jamo nodes and seed indices preserved
glyphMaterials.oldHangul: existing symbol fallback unchanged; no historical rendering support added

fixedCSSWholeVowelMapping.source: computed CSS font without a design; existing whole direct request source when a design applies
fixedCSSWholeVowelMapping.renderUnit: one whole direct material request and measurement; existing glyphFit may use multiple clipped paint cells, not one DOM leaf
fixedCSSWholeVowelMapping.priority: existing semantic CSS precedence and candidate-first parser; semantic choice precedes D16 visual capture
fixedCSSWholeVowelMapping.candidateOnly: see fixedCSSWholeVowelCandidateMapping for effective whole candidate IDs; candidate:none disables both candidate and text with original Hangul and no mapping error
fixedCSSWholeVowelMapping.none: unquoted none disables with original Hangul and no mapping error; quoted none is literal text
fixedCSSWholeVowelMapping.pendingOrFailedFont: existing current-request GLYPH_FONT_PENDING/GLYPH_FONT_LOAD_FAILED and replacement retry; old completion cannot restore removed choices
fixedCSSWholeVowelMapping.semantics: original source, semantic jamo, seed indices, direct path and saved design unchanged

fixedCSSWholeVowelCandidateMapping.candidateId: existing readIdent and ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$ ID syntax; a numeric token is an ID, never an array index
fixedCSSWholeVowelCandidateMapping.lookup: existing whole direct request source, compatibility root jamo, rootRole medial and path []; role-specific entry precedes generic; no member recipe inference or cross-source borrowing
fixedCSSWholeVowelCandidateMapping.priority: existing locked mapping before explicit candidate ID, then existing seed/selected/default; effective candidate precedes text and D16 capture
fixedCSSWholeVowelCandidateMapping.none: candidate:none disables both candidate and text with original Hangul and no mapping error
fixedCSSWholeVowelCandidateMapping.missing: GLYPH_CANDIDATE_MISSING and whole semantic-jamo fallback for missing design, whole glyph mapping, source/role match or candidate ID; locked selection can override the explicit ID
fixedCSSWholeVowelCandidateMapping.invalidRegistration: mapping candidates[] and other invalid glyph mappings remain DESIGN_GLYPHS_INVALID registration failures
fixedCSSWholeVowelCandidateMapping.renderUnit: one whole direct material request and measurement; existing glyphFit may use multiple clipped paint cells, not one DOM leaf
fixedCSSWholeVowelCandidateMapping.pendingOrFailedFont: existing current-request GLYPH_FONT_PENDING/GLYPH_FONT_LOAD_FAILED and replacement retry; old completion cannot restore removed choices
fixedCSSWholeVowelCandidateMapping.semantics: original source, semantic jamo, seed indices, direct path and saved design unchanged

browser.segmentation: engine Intl.Segmenter when available; code point fallback otherwise

layouts.appliesTo: page design layout > page --fy-layout > font design layout > --fy-font-layout > implicit default; a design with no layout inherits; legacy disables only design; a named sebul keeps its context layout unless a layout is explicitly selected

htmlOptions.compositionPrecedence: per-jamo design rules > page (--fy-vowel-depth/--fy-coda-depth > --fy-composition > --fy-jamo-depth) > design composition > font (longhand depth > --fy-font-composition > --fy-font-jamo-depth) > shape default (ADR-034 §3)

python.customFonts: per-call FontDefinition with trusted CSS and explicit metadata

layouts.appliesTo: calls that name no font (missing or empty) and pass no FontDefinition; any named font, including sebul, default and whitespace-only names, keeps its context layout
layouts.depth: caller longhand > caller shorthand > layout/font default; depth arguments are applied
layouts.face: element strokes for calls that name no font, as the runtime default: the generated element table (spec/element-layer.json, ADR-027) adds data-fy-face="element", --fy-face-width and [part="hoek"] > [part="element"] to the shaped jamo nodes (initial, medial and final nodes, placed by the bundled core CSS shape rules, ADR-030) and standalone compatibility jamo; the device option keeps device glyph text at the same shape values; named fonts and FontDefinition always draw device glyph text and reject element

composition.applies: the split part (vowel, coda) through the depth path; the host gets data-fy-composition (the preset, or custom when a longhand changed an axis); none, "" and auto choose nothing
composition.diagnostic: data-fy-composition-status="COMPOSITION_UNSUPPORTED" — the pieces levels keep the default strokes in static HTML
composition.squareSplitFit: not run — a named font's non-default split keeps its font CSS places (the runtime with --fy-split-fit: none)
